svg.title: The whole preprocessing pipeline. 1, pull out the content: web pages and slides label themselves, PDFs and images need layout detection or a vision transformer. 2, normalize everything into the same labeled building blocks. 3, keep tables as HTML, add summaries, and spot-check the numbers. 4, save the results so extraction is paid for once. 5, add metadata like page numbers, dates and chapters. 6, chunk by section, store in a vector database, and search with meaning plus filters.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From a messy pile of files to text an AI can use
